readme:
Art Deco Golden: Art Deco 55% + Gatsby Era 25% + Geometric Gold 20%.

**Blend:** Art Deco 55% + Gatsby Era 25% + Geometric Gold 20%  
**Temperature:** 5/10 (balanced) · **Formality:** 8/10 · **Tags:** premium, hospitality  
**Perfect for:** Luxury Hotels, Premium Events, Elegant Venues

## Content fundamentals

- Write for members and staff of the organization: direct, formal and composed.
- Headings name the thing plainly: “Art Deco Elegance”, “Private Banking”, “Luxury Residences”, “Fine Art Advisory”.
- Buttons are short verb phrases in Title Case: “Submit Inquiry”, “Reset”, “Primary Action”, “Secondary Action”.
- Navigation uses single nouns: “Portfolio”, “Services”, “About”, “Contact”.
- The reference page uses emoji as inline glyphs (©); keep them functional, never decorative.

## Color

- Set the page on `page-bg` with body text in `page-text`. The theme is dark.
- Identity colours: `color-gold`, `color-emerald`, `color-cream`, `color-burgundy`. Lead with the first; use the rest for accents and emphasis.
- Status colours (`color-success`, `color-warning`, `color-error`, `color-info`) always travel with a word or icon; never signal state by hue alone.
- Each token's note says where the reference page uses it and, for text colours, its contrast on `page-bg`. Keep body text at 4.5:1 or better.

## Typography

- `display` — "Poiret One", cursive
- `body` — Raleway, sans-serif

Faces are hosted on Google Fonts (Poiret One, Raleway); load them with:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poiret+One&family=Raleway:wght@400;600;700;800&display=swap">
```

- Set titles in `display`, sections in `heading-2` and running text in `body`.
- Uppercase is reserved for small labels (`label`, `button`), always with the letter-spacing given.

## Spacing, shape and elevation

- Spacing steps: `space-1` 0.5rem, `space-2` 1rem, `space-3` 1.5rem, `space-4` 2rem, `space-6` 3rem, `space-8` 4rem. Pad cards and sections from these steps only.
- Corners: `radius-sm` 2px, `radius-md` 4px, `radius-lg` 0px.
- Elevation: `shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`, `shadow-lg`, `shadow-gold-glow`, lowest first for resting cards, higher for hover and overlays.

- Color System:
- ├─ Primary: #D4AF37 (Classic Gold) - Luxury, prosperity, elegance
- ├─ Secondary: #0A0A0A (Rich Black) - Sophistication, drama, contrast
- ├─ Accent: #50C878 (Emerald) - Jewel-tone richness, vitality
- ├─ Neutral Light: #F5F5DC (Cream/Beige) - Refined warmth, champagne
- ├─ Accent 2: #800020 (Burgundy) - Velvet depth, wine sophistication
- Metallic: Linear gradients simulating gold, brass, bronze

- Metallic Gradients:
- ├─ Gold: linear-gradient(135deg, #f9d423 0%, #d4af37 50%, #aa8b2e 100%)
- ├─ Brass: linear-gradient(135deg, #E6BE8A 0%, #C9A961 50%, #A68B3E 100%)
- ├─ Bronze: linear-gradient(135deg, #CD7F32 0%, #B87333 50%, #9C6329 100%)
- Platinum: linear-gradient(135deg, #E5E4E2 0%, #C9C0BB 50%, #B0A9A4 100%)

- Typography System:
- ├─ Display: Poiret One (Headers)
- │  ├─ Weight: 400 (elegant, refined)
- │  ├─ Usage: H1-H3, luxury statements, hero text
- │  ├─ Personality: Geometric elegance, Art Deco sophistication
- │  └─ Cultural Reference: 1920s luxury posters, fashion advertisements
- Body: Raleway (Content)
- ├─ Weights: 400 (regular), 600 (semi-bold), 700 (bold), 800 (extra-bold)
- ├─ Usage: Paragraphs, UI text, data
- ├─ Rationale: Elegant legibility, refined geometry
- Contrast: Ornamental display vs. structured body

- Spacing & Rhythm:
- ├─ Base Unit: 8px
- ├─ Scale: 0.5x, 1x, 1.5x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 6x, 8x
- ├─ Layout Philosophy: Symmetrical precision, mathematical balance
- Grid System: Strong vertical rhythm, golden ratio proportions

- Component Design Principles:
- ├─ Cards: Beveled edges, golden borders, stepped corners
- ├─ Buttons: Geometric shapes with metallic gradients
- ├─ Forms: Art Deco frames with chevron details
- ├─ Tables: Alternating rows with subtle gold accents
- Navigation: Geometric badges with Art Deco ornaments

- ACCESSIBILITY COMPLIANCE

- WCAG 2.1 AA Standards:
- ├─ Color Contrast Ratios:
- │  ├─ Gold on Black: 8.5:1 (AAA)
- │  ├─ Cream on Black: 16.2:1 (AAA)
- │  ├─ Black on Cream: 16.2:1 (AAA)
- │  ├─ Emerald on Black: 6.9:1 (AA)
- │  └─ Burgundy on Cream: 8.1:1 (AAA)
- ├─ Focus Indicators:
- │  ├─ 3px solid gold outlines
- │  ├─ High contrast against black backgrounds
- │  └─ Visible offset for layered elements
- ├─ Touch Targets: Minimum 44x44px
- Screen Reader Support:
- ├─ Semantic HTML5 elements
- ├─ ARIA labels for decorative geometric patterns
- Alt text for ornamental Art Deco elements

- Responsive Breakpoints:
- ├─ Mobile: 320px-767px (single column, maintained elegance)
- ├─ Tablet: 768px-1023px (2-column grids, scaled geometry)
- Desktop: 1024px+ (full symmetric layouts, maximum impact)

- CULTURAL & BUSINESS CONTEXT

- Target Industries:
- ├─ Premium Hospitality: Luxury hotels, high-end restaurants, exclusive clubs
- ├─ Luxury Retail: Fine jewelry, haute couture, premium accessories
- ├─ Financial Services: Private banking, wealth management, investment firms
- ├─ Real Estate: Luxury properties, penthouses, historic buildings
- ├─ Entertainment: Opera houses, theaters, upscale venues
- Professional Services: Law firms, consultancies, executive services

- User Psychology:
- ├─ Temperature: 5/10 (Neutral-cool, refined sophistication)
- ├─ Formality: 8/10 (Highly formal, exclusive, aspirational)
- ├─ Emotional Response: Aspiration, elegance, prestige, exclusivity
- Trust Signals: Luxury, establishment, heritage, excellence

- Brand Personality:
- ├─ Voice: Sophisticated, refined, confident, exclusive
- ├─ Values: Excellence, heritage, craftsmanship, prestige
- ├─ Differentiation: Timeless elegance vs. contemporary minimalism
- Community: Discerning clientele, connoisseurs, elite circles

- TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION

- CSS Architecture:
- ├─ Custom Properties: All colors, gradients, spacing, typography
- ├─ Utility Classes: Minimal, component-focused
- ├─ Layout System: CSS Grid for symmetry, Flexbox for components
- Performance: Optimized gradients, GPU-accelerated transforms

- Browser Compatibility:
- ├─ Modern Browsers: Full feature support (gradients, clip-path)
- ├─ Graceful Degradation: Solid gold fallback if gradients unsupported
- Progressive Enhancement: Geometric patterns as enhancements

- Interaction Design:
- ├─ Hover States: Metallic gleam intensification, subtle scale
- ├─ Active States: Pressed depth with shadow reduction
- ├─ Focus States: Gold glow outlines, high elegance
- Transitions: Smooth, refined (300ms), luxurious easing

- Geometric Pattern Implementation:
- ├─ Chevrons: CSS clip-path or border triangles
- ├─ Sunbursts: Radial gradients with conic patterns
- ├─ Stepped Forms: Multiple nested borders
- Ziggurats: Layered elements with offset positioning

- USAGE GUIDELINES

- When to Use:
- ├─ Luxury brands requiring premium positioning
- ├─ High-end hospitality and entertainment venues
- ├─ Financial services targeting affluent clients
- ├─ Heritage brands with Art Deco architectural ties
- Premium products and services demanding elegance

- When NOT to Use:
- ├─ Casual consumer products (too formal)
- ├─ Tech startups (period mismatch)
- ├─ Budget services (contradicts positioning)
- ├─ Youth brands (generation mismatch)
- Minimalist brands (aesthetic conflict)

- Customization Notes:
- ├─ Gold adjustment: Maintain metallic gradient quality
- ├─ Typography: Keep geometric display + refined body pairing
- ├─ Pattern density: Adjustable detail level for different contexts
- Contrast: High black-gold contrast is signature element

- Historical Context:
- ├─ Peak Period: 1920s-1930s (Art Deco movement)
- ├─ Key Influences: Chrysler Building, Rockefeller Center, ocean liners
- ├─ Revival Periods: 1980s luxury, 2010s Great Gatsby film
- Modern Interpretation: Cleaner execution, digital adaptations

- Cultural References:
- ├─ Architecture: Skyscrapers, ocean liners, exhibition halls
- ├─ Fashion: Flapper dresses, sharp tailoring, jewelry
- ├─ Entertainment: Jazz clubs, speakeasies, ballrooms
- Design: Posters, advertisements, luxury packaging

## States and motion

Timing values: `--transition-fast` 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), `--transition-base` 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), `--transition-slow` 400ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).

- Honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: drop lifts and transitions to instant state changes.

## Iconography

- Inline SVG line icons on a 24×24 viewBox, 2px stroke, drawn in `currentColor` so they take the text colour around them.
- No logo ships with this style: set the organization name in the `display` style.

## Accessibility

- `page-text` on `page-bg` measures 5.3:1.
- Every interactive element shows a visible focus state at 3:1 or better against its surface.
- These fall under 3:1 on `page-bg`: `color-black` 1.0:1. Never set text in them on `page-bg`, at any size; use them as text only on a fill whose measured pairing meets 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text).

## Not synced

Built from `style-184-art-deco-golden.html`. No component bundle: the reference page's markup is not packaged as live components. Variables not representable as tokens (calc/clamp/gradients/font stacks): `--gradient-gold`, `--gradient-brass`, `--gradient-bronze`, `--gradient-dark`.
